turns.patient_response: Hi, Dr. Lee. Well, what brings me in is that I just cannot keep my mind on one thing anymore. It's getting really frustrating. I'll be working, and just hearing one saw start up, or seeing somebody walk past the office, or even just having a passing thought about a different job... it completely pulls me off whatever I'm doing. And then, before I know it, the whole day just gets away from me.

turns.doctor_question: Can you tell me when this difficulty staying focused first started — has it been a lifelong pattern since childhood, or is this something new that began more recently?
turns.patient_response: It's definitely a lifelong pattern. Even back in grade school, well before I was 12, my teachers were always telling my mother that I was bright but careless. turns.doctor_question: Aside from work, do these same problems with focus and restlessness also cause noticeable difficulties in other areas of your life, like at home or in your relationships?
